$comment: FF-51 fixture. One gallery document per layout that audit A (support-status.json at core 60e73d4) flagged "export shape placement ignores layout that changes preview". Each document is exactly what pptx-gallery lib/opf-snippets.ts buildOpfSnippet("layouts", id) emits at the recorded gallery commit; regenerate with gallery-alignment-layouts.mjs.txt. FA-23 (2026-10-07): converted in place to the OPF 0.15 shape (catalogs.default with source https://www.pptx.gallery, records keyed by id without $schema, id or x-* metadata; the 0.14 image fill design key (crop, fit) became design.imageFit (cover, contain)), as the 0.15 gallery embeds them.
